validationReport.statement: PDF file is not compliant with Validation Profile requirements.

rule.description: LI element may contain only Lbl and LBody elements

check.context: root/document[0]/StructTreeRoot[0](25 0 obj PDStructTreeRoot)/K[0](26 0 obj SEDocument Document)/K[1](57 0 obj SENonStruct NonStruct)/K[1](60 0 obj SEL L)/K[0](61 0 obj SELI LI)
check.errorMessage: LI element contains Link element(s) instead of Lbl or LBody

rule.description: Links shall contain an alternate description via their Contents key as described in ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.9.3

check.errorMessage: A link annotation does not include an alternate description in the Contents key

rule.description: The Catalog dictionary of a conforming file shall contain the Metadata key whose value is a metadata stream as defined in ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.3.2. The metadata stream dictionary shall contain entry Type with value /Metadata and entry Subtype with value /XML

check.errorMessage: The document catalog dictionary doesn't contain metadata key or metadata stream dictionary does not contain either entry Type with value /Metadata or entry Subtype with value /XML

rule.description: An annotation (except Widget annotations or hidden annotations, or those having rectangle outside the crop-box) shall have either Contents key or an Alt entry in the enclosing structure element
rule.test: Subtype == 'Widget' || isOutsideCropBox == true || (F & 2) == 2 || (Contents != null && Contents != '') || (Alt != null && Alt != '')

check.errorMessage: Link annotation whose hidden flag is not set and whose rectangle is not outside the crop-box has neither Contents key nor an Alt entry in the enclosing structure element

rule.description: Figure tags shall include an alternative representation or replacement text that represents the contents marked with the Figure tag as noted in ISO 32000-1:2008, 14.7.2, Table 323

check.context: root/document[0]/StructTreeRoot[0](25 0 obj PDStructTreeRoot)/K[0](26 0 obj SEDocument Document)/K[2](105 0 obj SEArt Art)/K[0](106 0 obj SENonStruct NonStruct)/K[3](135 0 obj SENonStruct NonStruct)/K[2](140 0 obj SEFigure Figure)
check.errorMessage: Figure structure element neither has an alternate description nor a replacement text

rule.description: Content shall be marked as Artifact or tagged as real content

check.errorMessage: Content is neither marked as Artifact nor tagged as real content
